2: the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number
2-dimensional: lacking the expected range or depth; not designed to give an illusion or depth
2-hitter: a game in which a pitcher allows the opposing team only 2 hits
2-hydroxybenzoic acid: a white crystalline substance with a bitter aftertaste; used as a fungicide or in making aspirin or dyes or perfumes
2-methylpropenoic acid: an unsaturated acid (C4H6O2) used to make resins and plastics
